slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 胥国，云州，余唐镇。
一条大河自镇中穿过。
巨大的货船行在河道中，两侧传来纤夫嘿呦嘿呦的号子。
“水生，快些吃，来活了！”
李水生连忙两口吃下一个馍馍，仔细品味最后一口，吞咽下去。
嘴里残留的食物香气让他颇为满足。
他穿着一条粗布裤子，赤着上身，眉眼清秀，额头绑着一条皂巾。
七尺来高，并不健壮，但很健康。
看见货船上密密麻麻的麻袋，让他露出一抹笑意。
又能挣好些铜钱了！
他关上了眼前自由浮现的面板：
【李水生】
寿元：14无尽
技艺：无
除了名字便只有这么两项，可以随意开关。
身为一个穿越者，他唯一能依仗的便是长生这个金手指了。
前世，他便是个病秧子，从小身体就不好，算是受尽了折磨。
今生，虽然重生到了古代，开局还是父母双亡，无亲无故……
那又怎样，他不仅身体倍好！
还长生了啊！
短暂的兴奋之后，他开始思考。
他所处的这个世界并不太平。
胥国立国三百载，已经有王朝末年的景象。
镇子不大，却有着帮派争斗，武功绝学，凶人过境。
甚至于，他还听人说起过仙人传说。
“习武，求仙！”
他心中确定了今后的路。
毕竟……
虽然长生了，但他只是寿元无尽，如果被杀，还是会寄的！
因此必要的杀人防护技能还是要有的！
他不想在想前世一样，无法掌控自己的性命！
又吃了一个馒头，李水生站起了身。
说来也怪，穿越之后，身体好似二次生长了一般，总是饿。
吃了东西之后肌肉长得很快，才一个月功夫，已经有了四块腹肌。
寻常脚夫吃两个馒头就饱了，他早上一顿要吃六个，晚上还要吃四个。
一天的工钱，光吃饭就用去三分之一。
好在力气也是飞涨，之前累得半死不活，现在一天倒是觉得很轻松。
陈叔都说，他简直就是天生干脚夫的料。
content_en:
Xu State, Yunzhou, Yutang Town.
A large river runs through the town.
The huge cargo ship was traveling in the river, and the trackers' hey, hey, hey chants came from both sides.
"Shui Sheng, eat quickly, come to life!"
Li Shuisheng hurriedly took two bites of a steamed bun, savored the last bite carefully, and swallowed.
The aroma of food remaining in his mouth made him quite satisfied.
He was wearing a pair of coarse trousers, his upper body was bare, his eyebrows were delicate, and a soap towel was tied to his forehead.
About seven feet tall, not muscular, but healthy.
Seeing the dense sacks on the cargo ship made him smile.
I can earn some copper coins again!
He closed the panel that floated freely in front of him:
【Li Shuisheng】
Life span: 14 endless
Skills: None
Apart from the name, there are only two items, which can be switched on or off at will.
As a time traveler, the only thing he can rely on is the golden finger of immortality.
In his previous life, he was a sick man. His health had been poor since he was a child, and he had suffered a lot.
In this life, even though I was reborn in ancient times, I started with both my parents dead and no relatives or friends...
So what, not only is he in better health!
He’s still alive!
After a brief moment of excitement, he began to think.
The world he lives in is not peaceful.
It has been three hundred years since the founding of Xu State, and the scene of the last years of the dynasty has already begun.
The town is not big, but there are gang wars, martial arts skills, and vicious people passing through.
He even heard people talk about immortal legends.
"Practice martial arts and seek immortality!"
The way forward was determined in his mind.
After all...
Although he is immortal, he only has endless longevity. If he is killed, he will still send it!
Therefore, you still need to have the necessary murder protection skills!
He didn't want to be like his previous life, unable to control his life!
...
After eating another steamed bun, Li Shuisheng stood up.
Strangely enough, after time traveling, my body seemed to have grown a second time and I was always hungry.
After eating, my muscles grew quickly. In just one month, I already had four packs of abs.
Normally, a porter would be full after eating two steamed buns. He would eat six in the morning and four in the evening.
A third of a day's wages is spent on food alone.
Fortunately, my strength has also skyrocketed. I was almost exhausted before, but now I feel very relaxed throughout the day.
Chen Shudu said that he was born to be a porter.
